desc.zh: 同一家公司，生意几乎没变，股价一年里却能上下差三成。这篇从“一股是对未来现金的一份索取权”讲起，经过折现、戈登增长模型、市盈率和席勒市盈率、股权风险溢价、CAPM 与因子、有效市场与过度波动、主动基金为什么大多跑不赢指数，再到泡沫和 2026 年 11 月的市场集中度与 AI 投资之争。十个可以动手的模型，八张示意图；只讲道理和证据，不是投资建议。
desc.en: The same company, its business barely changed, can see its share price swing thirty percent in a year. Starting from “a share is a claim on future cash”, the essay works through discounting, the Gordon growth model, P/E and Shiller's CAPE, the equity risk premium, CAPM and factors, efficient markets and excess volatility, why most active funds trail the index, bubbles, and the market concentration and AI-investment debate of November 2026. Ten models you can push, eight diagrams; mechanisms and evidence only, not investment advice.

title.zh: 现金流折现与戈登增长模型
title.en: Discounted cash flow and the Gordon growth model

desc.zh: 股票价值是未来给股东的现金逐年折现之和；永续增长时收成 P = D₁/(r − g)，r 靠近 g 时价格对利率极其敏感。
desc.en: A share is worth the discounted sum of the cash it pays owners; with perpetual growth this becomes P = D₁/(r − g), and as r nears g the price becomes extremely sensitive to rates.

zh: 为什么利率上升股票下跌
en: why do stocks fall when rates rise

title.en: The P/E ratio and reverse DCF

desc.zh: 市盈率等于派息率除以 r − g；倒过来解，一个市盈率对应一个隐含的增长率或一段必须实现的高增长期。
desc.en: P/E equals the payout ratio over r − g; solved backwards, a P/E implies a growth rate or a stretch of fast growth that must happen.

desc.zh: 用过去十年经通胀调整的平均利润做分母，避免衰退时当年市盈率失真；它对十年以上的回报有一定解释力，对一两年几乎没有。
desc.en: Dividing by ten years of inflation-adjusted earnings keeps recessions from distorting the ratio; it says something about returns over a decade or more and almost nothing about the next year or two.

zh: 衰退时市盈率为什么很高

desc.zh: 要求回报 = 无风险利率 + 股权风险溢价；隐含溢价从价格和现金预期里倒解，价格越高，溢价越低。
desc.en: Required return = risk-free rate + equity risk premium; the implied premium is solved from prices and expected cash, and the higher the price, the lower it is.

desc.zh: 只有分散不掉、和市场一起动的风险才有补偿；β 由回归估出，噪音很大，而且数据里的证券市场线比理论平。
desc.en: Only risk that cannot be diversified away, co-movement with the market, is paid; beta comes from a noisy regression, and in the data the security market line is flatter than theory says.

desc.zh: 法玛–弗伦奇的规模、价值、盈利、投资等因子比单一 β 描述得好；因子回报在被发表后变小，许多“因子”只是多重比较。
desc.en: Fama–French size, value, profitability and investment factors describe returns better than beta alone; factor returns shrink after publication, and many 'factors' are multiple comparisons.

desc.zh: 公开信息已在价格里，价格近似随机游走；可席勒发现价格比它代表的股息波动得还大，大部分波动来自折现率。
desc.en: Public information is already in the price, which moves roughly like a random walk; yet Shiller found prices swing more than the dividends they stand for, mostly because discount rates move.

zh: 格罗斯曼斯蒂格利茨悖论

title.zh: 主动管理的算术与指数基金
title.en: The arithmetic of active management and index funds

desc.zh: 主动投资者合起来就是市场，扣费后平均一定跑输；时间越长，运气被平均掉，费用留下来，SPIVA 测到二十年约九成三的大盘基金跑输。
desc.en: Active investors together are the market, so after costs the average must trail; over longer horizons luck averages out and fees remain, and SPIVA measured about 93% of large-cap funds trailing over twenty years.

zh: 指数基金为什么跑赢大多数基金
基金经理能跑赢大盘吗
en: can fund managers beat the market

title.zh: 2026 年的估值、集中度与 AI 投资之争
title.en: Valuations, concentration and the AI-investment debate in 2026

desc.zh: 2026 年 11 月：前十大公司约占标普 500 四成、席勒市盈率约 40 倍、大型科技公司资本开支接近 7,000 亿美元；AI 股是否泡沫，可以改写成一个反向 DCF 问题。
desc.en: November 2026: the top ten hold about 40% of the S&P 500, CAPE is near 40 and big-tech capex nears $700 billion; whether AI stocks are a bubble can be restated as a reverse-DCF question.
